segments.nethackrc:
OPTIONS=name:QuestTouchWizkitA27,role:Wizard,race:human,gender:female,align:neutral,playmode:debug,!legacy,!tutorial,!splash_screen,showexp,time,pettype:none
WIZKIT=.nethackrc
The Eye of the Aethiopica

comment: quest.c artitouch() reached at startup through the wizard kit. A debug neutral human female Wizard names her own .nethackrc as WIZKIT and lists The Eye of the Aethiopica, her own quest artifact. initoptions() rejects that line as 'Not a config statement'; files.c read_wizkit() then wishes for it, and wizkit_addinv() -> invent.c addinv_core1() -> artitouch() marks the artifact touched, calls qt_pager("gotit"), which questpgr.c skip_pager() silences while program_state.wizkit_wishing is set, and calls exercise(A_WIS, TRUE), whose rn2(19) the RNG log shows. It varies recipes/questpgr.c/wizkit-own-quest-artifact-skips-pager (a chaotic elven male) in race, gender and alignment. The keys dismiss the startup error and the welcome message, list the inventory to show the amulet, and close it.
